{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black structured blazer, cropped box cut, hip length, #000000, wool blend with a subtle sheen.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers, straight leg fall, ankle length, #1A1A2E, heavy crepe fabric.
Crisp button-down shirt, relaxed fit, mid-thigh hem, #FFFFFF, cotton poplin with raw edges.
Chunky black combat boots, flat heel, calf height, #000000, durable rubber and suede mix.
Silver geometric drop earrings, medium drop, dangling, #E8E8E8, oxidized sterling silver.

This outfit balances the edge of a rock concert with the smart social dress code by blending a structured blazer with deconstructed details like raw-edge shirt hems. The dark monochromatic palette in cool-toned fabrics suits the artificial club lighting and autumn evening weather while allowing movement through the standing crowd. Wide-leg trousers paired with chunky combat boots provide stability and a modern silhouette that feels both effortless and intentionally styled for a Friday night out."}
